actions.title: Your ELI AI model has been updated
actions.html:
Your AI model has been switched from gemini-flash-lite-latest to gemini-flash-latest by your administrator.

The previous model had started returning incomplete results. The clearest symptom: Error Review reported no errors found on documents that clearly contained errors. Other AI tools were quietly returning weaker answers as well.

The new model corrects this. No action is needed on your part.

featured.name: Polish
featured.desc: Select any passage and get three rewrites side by side — polished, plainer, formal. Edit them in place, regenerate just one, lock wording that must not change, then swap your pick into Word. Select several paragraphs and it steps through them in order.
featured.where: Select text, then look for Polish Text in the Ask ELI box.

improved.text: Cards are colour-coded by error type, the fix text is larger, and the original collapses when you don't need it.
Applying a fix flashes the changed word yellow in the document and stamps the card FIXED.
A deterministic typography pass now catches every straight quote and apostrophe, without asking the AI.
The review step lists anything still unfilled, and the prev/next walk now includes header and footer fills.
ELI's read writes both columns — what changed and the likely purpose — and steps aside when you open Guidance.
Noticeably faster on long agreements, along with Review Redlines' guidance and audit.

fixed.text: Scans that came back "no errors found" when there clearly were.
A failed AI pass now says Scan incomplete instead of quietly reporting all clear.
Fixes that changed nothing no longer report as applied and reappear next scan.
False "dangling cross-reference" warnings on perfectly good section numbers.
Curly-quote findings that could never be applied and returned on every scan.
Header and footer fills kept 11pt over the template's 9pt.
Enhance lowercased Colgate and other defined terms when asked to start lowercase.
